subject: MAP draft: Performance replay milestone & scheduling (AuroraPay)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft: Performance replay milestone & scheduling (AuroraPay)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call today. As promised, attached is an updated MAP draft focused on the performance/load milestone so we can lock test windows and sizing before the end of the quarter. Key asks below so engineering can plan: 

1) Milestone: Traffic replay & peak QPS validation
   - Target window (proposal): Dec 8–10, 2026 (fall-back Dec 15–17)
   - Goal: validate end-to-end latency at 99th pct and stability at peak QPS of 3,000 QPS
   - Redwood responsibility: provide dedicated capacity pool, coordinated replay harness, KV prefix caching for replay runs
   - AuroraPay responsibility: share replay dataset + seed traffic template; run local smoke test day-of before full ramp

2) Dependencies & blockers
   - Replay dataset delivery: AuroraPay to provide by Dec 1 (S3 share or secure Drive)
   - Network/L7 routing confirmation for VPC peering (if private deployment) by Dec 3
   - Signed scope addendum for dedicated capacity (DocuSign link pending)

3) Next steps / asks from you
   - Confirm preferred test window (Dec 8–10 or Dec 15–17)
   - Confirm dataset delivery path and engineering contact for replay handoff
   - Let us know any additional non-functional KPIs beyond 99p latency and error rate target < 0.5%

Attached: redwood-map-draft-v2.docx, traffic-replay-instructions.pdf

If that all looks good I’ll loop Neha (performance lead) to draft the capacity estimate and lock the dedicated pool.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T +1 (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: redwood-map-draft-v2.docx] [Attachment: traffic-replay-instructions.pdf]
From: Sam Park <sam.park@aurorapay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@aurorapay.com>, Priya Desai <priya@infraops.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Performance replay milestone & scheduling (AuroraPay)

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear outline and draft. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm: 

- Peak QPS: our internal estimate for Black Friday-style peak is ~2,750 QPS sustained across 45 minutes with spikes to ~3,500 for ~30s. Can Redwood's dedicated pool support short spike headroom to 3.5k without throttling?
- Dataset: we can provide a 12-hour replay dump (anonymized) via a pre-signed S3 link; Maria (cc) will own the handoff.
- Scope addendum: what are the ballpark costs for the dedicated pool for the three-day window + 24-hour soak? We need that to loop in procurement.

We prefer Dec 8–10 as the primary window. Also, please add any checklist items we should run on our side before the replay (e.g., client-side rate limits, cookie/session mapping).

--Sam
Sam Park
Director, Platform Reliability | AuroraPay
sam.park@aurorapay.com
[External Attachment: none]
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Performance replay milestone & scheduling (AuroraPay)

Tessa / team —

Quick internal alignment based on Sam's questions: 

- Spike headroom: runtime can support short spikes to 3.5k QPS provided we reserve a dedicated pool sized for sustained 3k QPS and enable burst capacity (we recommend reserve for 3.2k sustained + 20% burst).
- Cost estimate: preliminary sizing attached (capacity-sizing-estimate.xlsx). For a 3-day plan + 24h soak we estimate the direct dedicated pool cost ~ $24k - $30k depending on instance family and preemptible use. We should surface exact SKU options to procurement.
- Pre-replay checklist for AuroraPay (we'll also publish a lightweight playbook):
   * Provide pre-signed S3 link with replay dataset (no PII, hashed ids)
   * Confirm session affinity mapping and token formats
   * Ensure client-side retry/backoff settings are disabled for the replay window
   * Smoke test: 30-minute local smoke at 25% load on morning of day 1

Neha — can you own the final capacity number and a brief runbook for the test engineers? Tessa — once we have that, I can draft the procurement note and high-level estimate for Sam.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: capacity-sizing-estimate.xlsx]

Tessa / Logan —

All good on our side. We confirm Dec 8–10 as the primary test window. Maria will upload the 12-hour replay dump to S3 by Dec 1 and will share the pre-signed link with your engineering contact once available. Procurement is OK to review the estimate; please send a short SKU-based quote for the dedicated pool (we can take the higher-fidelity number after Neha's sizing).

A couple quick notes/asks: 
- Please include a 30-minute ramp plan in the runbook (how fast you’ll ramp tokens/sec).
- We will need a DocuSign addendum for the dedicated pool + short SLA during the test window — can you route that to procurement (cc'd Priya)?

Once we have the DocuSign link and the S3 share, Maria and I will coordinate the day-of run. Looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Thanks,
Sam
